description: Turn a plug on or off for one connected account and set its configuration, replacing the plug's previous configuration. An activated plug later acts on that account's published posts automatically, in public, without asking again — confirm the exact plug and settings with the user first. Get valid plug keys and config fields from list_account_plugs.

activated.description: true to activate the plug, false to switch it off.

config.description: The plug's configuration as flat key → string/number/boolean values, using the configFields list_account_plugs returns. Replaces the existing configuration.

name: configure_account_plug
